project_type: Node.js/Express backend + Vanilla JS frontend with Tailwind CSS CDN, MongoDB Atlas database
build_system: npm scripts - no build step required (vanilla JS + CDN)
test_framework: Jest with Supertest for integration tests, mongodb-memory-server for in-memory database
build_command: none (vanilla JS + CDN, no compilation needed)
test_command: npm test (runs all tests with coverage), npm run test:unit, npm run test:integration
verification_instructions: Run npm test to execute all tests. Coverage must remain >80%. Manually test UI at http://localhost:5000 after starting with npm start or npm run dev.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none - no build artifacts or snapshots checked in
environment_constraints: MongoDB Atlas connection must not be changed. Do not modify database credentials in .env. Preserve existing student records. Port 5000 is used for dev server.
contribution_requirements: Preserve MVC architecture (models/, controllers/, routes/, middleware/). Maintain security features (helmet, CORS, validation). Keep asyncHandler pattern for controllers. Follow existing error handling patterns. All student CRUD operations must remain functional. Do not break existing validation rules.
key_patterns: Controllers use asyncHandler wrapper from middleware/asyncHandler.js. Routes use express-validator middleware chains (validateCreateStudent, validateUpdateStudent, validate). Error handling centralized in middleware/errorHandler.js. Mongoose models in models/ with schema validation. Frontend uses vanilla JS with Tailwind CDN, no frameworks. API calls use fetch(). HTML forms validated client-side before submission. Test utilities in tests/utils.js provide createTestStudent() factory.
directory_structure: Root contains app.js (Express app setup), server.js (entry point), start-server.js (connects DB then starts). config/ has database.js (MongoDB connection). controllers/ has studentController.js (getAllStudents, createStudent, updateStudent, deleteStudent). routes/ has studentRoutes.js (defines /api/students routes). models/ has Student.js (Mongoose schema: name, email, course, phone, age, timestamps). middleware/ has asyncHandler.js, errorHandler.js, validator.js. public/ has index.html and app.js (frontend). tests/ has setup.js (mongodb-memory-server), utils.js (test factories), integration/ and unit/ subdirectories.
